risks.risk: Torch may not charge properly or may have weak battery capacity (photos can’t confirm).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: plug into charger, show charging indicator (if any), then switch on and show brightness for at least 5–10 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven for charging/runtime (worst case: treat as basic/possibly weak battery).

risks.risk: LED/reflector may be dim, flickering, or partially faulty (photos can’t confirm).
risks.proof: Ask for a video with the torch ON in a dark room, plus a quick tap/tilt test to check flicker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working perfectly (worst case: assume reduced brightness).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (charger/cable/charging dock) or wrong charger type.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of everything included laid out (torch + charger/cable + any manual/warranty).
risks.if_unproven: Price as torch only (worst case: no charger included).

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (seller’s stated DP Compact may not match what’s pictured).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the label/engraving on the torch body and the charger label (model/voltage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic rechargeable LED torch (worst case: no identifiable premium model).

proof_requests: Video proof: torch switched ON in a dark area showing steady brightness (no flicker).
Charging proof: show it charging (indicator if any) and then run it for 5–10 minutes.
Photo of included items: charger/cable and any manual/warranty card/receipt.
Close-up of any label/engraving showing brand/model and charger specs.
